# Recap
If `GOALS.md` / `decisions.tsv` / a baby-sit resume file / prior recap exists, READ it first.
Do not re-run research, re-score sessions, or rebuild a roadmap
Every status/done/blocked claim must point at a concrete artifact
Missing trail is ok (say unknown); inventing one is not
Recap consumes the trail; it never owns or mutates `decisions.tsv`
COPY_PHRASES_RECAP_CANARY
